title: TaskVault
tagline: A decentralized freelancing-platform, which helps hiring web3-freelancers the web3-way (and more)
description: TaskVault is a platform designed to streamline the hiring process for freelancers. With TaskVault, you can easily find job listings, apply for jobs, and get hired. Once you're hired, the client will lock your rewards in a 2-of-3-multisig wallet for added security. Finally, complete your work and receive your payment in USDC.
how_its_made:
smart contract written in hardhat. Interface for ERC20. 
Front-End: Next.js, Tailwind for Styling, Moralis for Data Interaction with Smart Contract

that is it.
